scenario: Real MainChannelService and ChannelRepository use the Prisma client injected into createAppContext against PostgreSQL.

environment.database: Disposable PostgreSQL 17.11, tmpfs, all 84 migrations applied
environment.testBoundary: Real PostgreSQL and application service; explicit PrismaClient injection; no production or external services

result.visibleActiveChannel: Returned the row read through the injected client.

limits: This covers one injected service/repository cycle, not every application composition root or module import cycle.
The test uses one process and does not prove production bundler behavior or full HTTP composition.
